item.title: Parades rolling in New Orleans on Lundi Gras and Mardi Gras
item.description: With the home stretch of parades coming, here's the list of parades rolling on Lundi Gras and Mardi Gras.

item.title: New Orleans mayor signs executive order prohibiting local law enforcement from entering ICE agreements
item.description: Mayor Helena Moreno signed an executive order which will prohibit any public official from entering a "287(g) agreement," a method by which ICE "deputizes" local law enforcement to conduct immigration enforcement operations, according to the city.

item.title: Actor Patrick Warburton arrives in New Orleans for costume fitting for Bacchus parade
item.description: Actor Patrick Warburton arrived in New Orleans on Feb. 12, ahead of the Bacchus parade, which he is King Bacchus LVII.

item.title: Two women accused of child abuse by New Orleans police
item.description: The New Orleans Police Department is accusing two women of child abuse.

item.title: 17-year-old shot, killed in St. Bernard Parish: SBSO
item.description: Deputies with the St. Bernard Sheriff's Office are investigating a deadly shooting near East St. Bernard Highway and Colonial Boulevard on Feb. 12.

item.title: Orleans Parish inmate escapee Antoine Massey sentenced for kidnapping and rape
item.description: Orleans Parish inmate-escapee Antoine Massey was sentenced to 60 years in prison Thursday, Feb. 12 for the kidnapping and rape of his former girlfriend.

item.title: Mississippi man accused of child sex crimes, Terrebonne Parish deputies say
item.description: A Mississippi man was arrested on Feb. 2 in connection with a Terrebonne Parish child sex crimes investigation.

item.title: Foggy Friday morning then a nice afternoon
item.description: NEW ORLEANS (WGNO) — Quiet weather is sticking around to wrap up the workweek, but changes are on the horizon this weekend. High pressure will keep conditions dry and warmer than normal through Friday night, with afternoon highs reaching the mid-70s. item.title: St. Tammany Parish completes 1-90 Collins Bridge widening
item.description: Governor Jeff Landy and St. Tammany Parish leaders celebrated the end of a bridge project and the beginning of two more.

item.title: One dead, four injured in shooting at Hammond apartment complex: TPSO
item.description: The Tangipahoa Parish Sheriff's Office is investigating a shooting at the Willow Villa apartment complex that left one man dead and four people, including a 3-year-old, injured on Thursday, Feb. 12.
